depicted_variant: Alan ukuran manusia: roh perempuan tua bersayap, wajah berkerut keras, lengan panjang dan jari tangan/kaki mengarah ke belakang.

visual_requirements.description: Ukuran manusia, bersayap, jari mengarah ke belakang dari pergelangan dan jari kaki di belakang kaki; perempuan tua berwajah berkerut keras dan lengan panjang.
Terbang turun dari pohon; keagungan roh ibu asuh tanpa pemangsaan.
Hutan gelap, mata air dan rumah emas di latar jauh.

aura: Keagungan roh ibu asuh berasal dari turunnya tubuh bersayap dengan jari berbalik dan wajah keras, bukan sifat kanibal aran (alan-legendary-creature-c03, alan-legendary-creature-c22, alan-legendary-creature-c04).
artistic_choices: Varian ukuran manusia c03 dipilih; tidak memakai varian kecil c12 atau kanibal aran.
Dua sayap bertekstur membran, dua lengan dan kaki, lima digit masing-masing adalah jumlah/bahan editorial; semua digit harus mengikuti arah terbalik sumber.
Pakaian opak tunik tinggi sampai lutut dengan tangan/kaki telanjang agar ciri terbaca.
Rumah emas kecil hanya latar c05; tidak menggambar gore/birth-remains, api atau glow magis.
prompt:
EDIT the attached Alan image ONLY her TWO HANDS and TWO BARE FEET. Preserve face, pose, clothes, TWO wings, light, forest, spring and golden house exactly.
The accepted source requires fingers pointing BACKWARD FROM THE WRIST and toes at the BACK of each foot. Current hands point outward normally and feet wrongly have BOTH front and rear toes; correct this carefully.
HANDS: replace each whole hand with ONE reverse-oriented hand of exactly FIVE digits attached to its wrist. Her outstretched forearms remain. Every hand's fingers point INWARD TOWARD HER ELBOW / BODY, lying along the outer side of the forearm, not outward away from the arm and not downward. Each hand ends at the wrist in a blunt rounded palm tip at the outer edge; digits emerge backward from that wrist toward the elbow. FIVE digits per hand total, no normal outward fingers left.
FEET: each foot has exactly FIVE TOES TOTAL located ONLY at the BACK behind the ankle. Remove ALL ordinary toe bumps/nails at the FRONT ends closest to camera; these front ends must be smooth rounded heel-like stumps with NO DIGITS. Keep five rear-facing toes projecting behind each ankle at the heel, countable and clearly attached. No doubled toes.
Natural weathered skin, coherent reverse anatomy, never severed limb or gore. No added text, symbols, border, logo or watermark. Full opaque clothes remain. Preserve every other feature.
